steps.content: Half an hour passes, and you are still waiting in the data stream, completely unaware of how the god-slaying is unfolding.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: So right now we know that the target is on the road.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then... would monitoring the traffic in this world help? For example, can you track the cars heading toward 000's location and identify the people in them?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maybe tap a line or something?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Line tapped. That Sinner had the same idea. We can simply follow her path to the destination. I'm looking for that little duck.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But we can't check every car.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There must be hundreds of cars heading that way, and she could act at any moment. We can’t afford to find the wrong person. Can we get ahead of her?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Don't worry, the target has been located. I'll send you over right away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Although it's late at night, the traffic here is still bustling. I can tell this is a big city, just like Eastside. How did you manage to find the target so quickly?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Haha, because we are very lucky. In this world, Game 5732 is not very popular, and very few people have it installed.
You recall the two ducks you just met. Their devices had this game installed, and in that moment, everything clicks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you're saying that although few people play this game, the gods who created it must have Game 5732 on their phone.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: That's right. Guess how many phones in the cars possibly heading to your location have this game installed?
You smile.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Correct. The transmission link is generated. Chief, are you ready?
[Jump to murder scene]
You look outside the screen. The traffic has started to thin out, with only the traffic light blinking ahead.
Moore sends you a link, trying to connect the device you are in to the surveillance cameras outside.
You see the car still driving. Code Duck is clearly struggling to keep its drowsy eyes open to head for work.

steps.speaker: Code Duck
steps.content:
Quack... quack... Quack quack...
(Error, error... check the pointer...)
000 hasn't appeared yet, but the target is already a mess.

steps.speaker: Code Duck
steps.content:
Quack... Quack quack quack...
(Where is the bug...)
You couldn't wake it up. That's not surprising; your paper-thin body can't even break the glass, and people in this world might not understand your language.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: How's it going?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It is already half asleep even though it's still driving...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Rust

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It wouldn't take much effort on her part, and everyone would believe that Code Duck died in a car crash from fatigue driving late at night.
In any case, you must alert this duck somehow before 000 arrives.
Suddenly, you feel a jolt, like an earthquake, or a bomb went off!

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Don't worry. It has already been intercepted.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: But be careful, Chief, she's also here.
Everything around you is now covered in a thick layer of white gauze and slows down a thousand times. You see a stream of light slowly shooting toward the target!
The duck is unaware and is still struggling to keep its eyes open.
You're here! I knew you'd choose me of your own free will. I'm not being sarcastic, I'm genuinely happy...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Cut it out. I'm here to stop you.
Alright, alright. The assassination game starts now!
In this special force field, I'm the assassin, you're the guard, and we both have special combat techniques. Let's have some fun.
She disappears, leaving only a bullet trail gliding slowly toward its target.
